title: Opening of the interview and birth in New York
summary: Kirchner opens the tape and confirms Mandel's birth on November 23, 1925 on West End Avenue; he lived on the upper west side for his first seven years.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.

Alright so this is April 20th, 1995, in New York City, on the 38th floor of a New York midtown office building and this is Bill Kirchner with tape one of our interview with Johnny Mandel. I guess the easiest thing to do is start at the very beginning, according to all the records you were born on November 23rd, 1925 is that correct?
I’m afraid that’s the awful truth, I sure was.
Right in New York on 85th and West End.
So you lived on the upper west side then?
No, for my first seven years.
